description: Kabsch superposition and TM-score of the mug151 AlphaFold core onto experimental SAP30BP chain A of PDB 9QKZ, with domain architecture and evidence-provenance panels
code:
import os, json, requests
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("provenance", exist_ok=True)
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}

af_txt = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q10069-F1-model_v6.pdb", headers=H, timeout=120).text
af_core={}
for l in af_txt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        r=int(l[22:26])
        if 31<=r<=131: af_core[r]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])

ex_txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9QKZ.pdb", headers=H, timeout=120).text
ex={}
for l in ex_txt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA' and l[21]=='A':
        ex[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
print("9QKZ chain A CA observed:", min(ex), "-", max(ex), "n =", len(ex))
print("mug151 core CA:", min(af_core), "-", max(af_core), "n =", len(af_core))

qAln="SFSERVRNMSPD--------EIKIPPEPPGRCSNHLQDKIQKLYERKIKEGMDMNYIIQRKKEFRNPSIYEKLIQFCAI-DELGTNYPKDMFDPHGWSEDSYYEALAKAQKIEMDKLEKA"
tAln="EEQTSLVNENNDIKGRSEEPHWKIPNSPKAEVDTELEKKIKQFIKLKA-KGIHFHTRLSENENFRNPKLLDNLQDFLDIKEPRGTMISKDMWDPTDFHKNVYASALSKSQDEMIARRENY"
qi,ti,off=7,11,97
pairs=[]; missing=0
for a,b in zip(qAln,tAln):
    if a!='-' and b!='-':
        qr,tr = off+qi+1, ti+1
        if qr in ex and tr in af_core: pairs.append((qr,tr,a,b))
        else: missing+=1
    if a!='-': qi+=1
    if b!='-': ti+=1
print(f"alignment columns with both residues present in coordinates: {len(pairs)} (dropped {missing} with unobserved density)")

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])
    return Pc@(V@D@Wt), Qc
P=np.array([ex[p[0]] for p in pairs]); Q=np.array([af_core[p[1]] for p in pairs])

cur=list(range(len(pairs))); curve=[]
while True:
    A,B=kabsch(P[cur],Q[cur]); d=np.linalg.norm(A-B,axis=1)
    curve.append((len(cur), float(np.sqrt((d**2).mean()))))
    if len(cur)<=20: break
    cur=[cur[i] for i in np.argsort(d)[:max(20,int(len(cur)*0.93))]]
curve=np.array(curve)

A,B=kabsch(P,Q); d=np.linalg.norm(A-B,axis=1)
def tm(d,L):
    d0=1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8
    return float(np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L)
tm118, tm101 = tm(d,118), tm(d,101)
print(f"all-pairs ({len(pairs)}) RMSD = {np.sqrt((d**2).mean()):.2f} A")
print(f"TM-score normalised by 118 (experimental chain) = {tm118:.3f}")
print(f"TM-score normalised by 101 (mug151 core)        = {tm101:.3f}")
print("trim curve:", [(int(n),round(r,2)) for n,r in curve])

edges=[('tho1',0.777,0.761),('cdk11',0.696,0.684),('lcp1',0.611,0.611),
       ('sap62',0.535,0.498),('wdr83',0.469,0.451),('prp2',0.459,0.451)]
biogrid=[('par1','positive'),('wdr7','positive'),('rsv2','negative'),
         ('prp22','negative'),('xap5','negative')]
arch={'Human SAP30BP\n(Q9UHR5, 308 aa)':dict(L=308,pf=(118,215),ulm=(252,257)),
      'S. pombe mug151\n(Q10069, 146 aa)':dict(L=146,pf=(34,127),ulm=None)}

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(curve[:,0],curve[:,1],'o-',color='#1f77b4',ms=4)
for n,r in curve:
    if int(n) in (98,84,58,40):
        ax.annotate(f"{int(n)} pairs, {r:.2f} A",(n,r),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(5,7),fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(2.0,ls=':',c='grey'); ax.invert_xaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("CA pairs retained"); ax.set_ylabel("RMSD (A)")
ax.set_title(f"A. Kabsch fit of mug151 core 31-131 onto 9QKZ chain A\n"
             f"TM-score {tm118:.3f} (norm 118) and {tm101:.3f} (norm 101)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
for i,(name,dd) in enumerate(arch.items()):
    y=1-i
    ax.barh(y,dd['L'],height=0.3,color='#dddddd',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
    s,e=dd['pf']; ax.barh(y,e-s,left=s,height=0.3,color='#4c72b0',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
    ax.text(s+(e-s)/2,y,"PF07818",ha='center',va='center',color='w',fontsize=8)
    if dd['ulm']:
        s2,e2=dd['ulm']; ax.barh(y,8,left=s2,height=0.3,color='#c44e52',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
        ax.annotate("ULM KRKSKW 252-257\nbinds RBM17 UHM",(e2,y),textcoords="offset points",
                    xytext=(10,-4),fontsize=8,color='#c44e52')
    else:
        ax.annotate("no ULM, no Trp in C-tail;\nno RBM17 ortholog in S. pombe",(dd['L'],y),
                    textcoords="offset points",xytext=(10,-4),fontsize=8,color='#555555')
    ax.text(-8,y,name,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-150,470); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,1.6); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_title("B. Only the PF07818 core is shared",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[2]
ax.barh(range(len(edges)),[e[2] for e in edges],color='#8172b2',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(edges))); ax.set_yticklabels([e[0] for e in edges],fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("STRING experiments-channel score"); ax.set_xlim(0,1.25)
for i,e in enumerate(edges):
    ax.text(e[2]+0.02,i,"0 physical records in BioGRID",va='center',fontsize=7,color='#8172b2')
ax.set_title("C. All mug151 STRING edges are experiments-only\n"
             "(database = 0, text = 0); BioGRID holds 5 genetic\n"
             "interactions, including prp22 and xap5",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

json.dump({"n_pairs":len(pairs),"dropped_unobserved":missing,"tm_norm118":tm118,
           "tm_norm101":tm101,"all_pairs_rmsd":float(np.sqrt((d**2).mean())),
           "trim_curve":curve.tolist(),"string_edges":edges,"biogrid_genetic":biogrid},
          open("provenance/iter2_superposition_and_evidence_provenance.json","w"),indent=1)
print("wrote provenance/iter2_superposition_and_evidence_provenance.json")
